title: Rally browser game component diagram
description: The browser side of Rally: a pure engine, the page that wires it to the DOM, drawing and input, the high-score client and online play.

components.name: Rally browser game
components.responsibility: Everything that runs in the browser.

components.name: Engine
components.responsibility: The pure match simulation, the computer player and replay; no DOM, no timers.

components.name: UI
components.responsibility: Canvas drawing, keys, touch and mouse, synthesised sound and the name-entry keyboard.

components.name: Page (main.ts)
components.responsibility: Menus and screens, the 120 Hz fixed-step loop, recording, name entry, the table, the scoreboard and online matches.

components.name: Online play (online.ts)
components.responsibility: The match's WebSocket (Room) and the lockstep of every player's controls (Lockstep). Identical in Rally, Hivestorm and Shatterbelt.

components.name: High-score client (scores.ts)
components.responsibility: Seeds, submitting matches, loading the table and the session name.

components.name: Name rules (name.ts)
components.responsibility: Cleans names for the table, the same as Samosa's rules.

components.name: High-score Worker
components.responsibility: The server side of the table.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at games.icelander.net (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in, /me, the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.

relationships.description: Steps matches, drives the computer, records the player's controls and scores the match.
